name: Arihant Academy Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1998, Arihant Academy Ltd runs premium coaching classes in  Mumbai for SSC, ICSE, CBSE, Science 
& Commerce[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
AAL is a leading educational institution in Mumbai, Maharashtra, offering coaching services for students from Class 8 to 12 across various boards, with specialized programs for Science and Commerce streams. It also prepares students for competitive exams through its 20+ coaching centers, serving around 10,000 students with a hybrid teaching model that blends traditional classroom instruction with digital learning.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 60.3% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 10.3 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.90%
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.28 Cr.
